description:
Cross Platform Xray-core Client

OneXray is a cross-platform Xray-core client for managing proxy configurations and VPN/TUN connections.
Clearer subscriptions and smarter configuration tools
- Subscription plan information: View provider-reported traffic usage, quota, remaining data, and expiry when available. Lists show a summary; subscription details show the available fields and fetch time. These figures update with the subscription, not in real time, and do not replace current-connection traffic counters.
- JSON editing assistance: Common-field/value, tag, and installed GeoData suggestions for nodes, advanced Custom Routing, and Raw JSON. Syntax errors have line/column locations; reliable field errors can select the corresponding source. Core errors retain their explanation without guessing a location.
- Editor and save fixes: Improved copy/paste menus and shortcuts, useful import/save diagnostics, and preservation of newer draft edits when an earlier save finishes.
- Desktop local HTTP API: Opt in under Advanced > Xray > Local API to validate configurations or generate previews through the running app. The interface is off by default, listens only on IPv4 loopback, and requires a random Bearer token. The port is configurable; automatic Xray SOCKS/metrics ports avoid it even while the API is disabled. No separate CLI is required.
- Hysteria2 sharing: Restored import/export for supported authentication, IPv6, SNI, Salamander, and multi-port options. TLS verification is required; unsupported insecure and certificate-pinning semantics are rejected. Legacy VMessQrCode and Clash/Mihomo configurations remain unsupported.
- Platform improvements: Windows/Linux apply the selected outbound interface to supported UDP port-hopping sockets. Improved Windows packaging compatibility and configuration dependency handling.
- Steadier macOS menu bar: Removed changing speed text and redundant tray updates. Live speeds and current-session traffic remain on Connect; Android widget and notification statistics remain available.
- Optional donations: A Donate page provides a copyable Solana USDC/USDT address. No purchase is required to use OneXray.
Updating from 26.9.4 preserves configurations and preferences. Subscription plan details appear after a successful refresh when the provider supplies them. The local API does not import data or start VPN; successful validation does not prove server connectivity or VPN startup. Keep API tokens and returned configurations private.
OneXray remains a bring-your-own-server client with no account, ads, or app analytics.
